question: Which goddesses protect the practitioner in the sky and in all places?
premises: Varadā is invoked for protection in the sky
Bhuvaneśvarī is invoked for protection everywhere
Protection is sought in all spatial domains
inference: Varadā protects in the sky and Bhuvaneśvarī protects everywhere
plain_english: May Varadā protect in the sky, and may Bhuvaneśvarī protect everywhere.
